metadata.description: Claude Code and Codex plugins that work together: a Codex bridge, a plan-and-run loop, code review skills, and repo instruction docs.

plugins.name: recode
plugins.description: Hand a task to the Codex CLI, run it once, and print what it said. Also keeps a block of house rules in your CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: recode-loop
plugins.description: Run a tiered plan, review, implement, review, publish loop for one unit of work, with Claude orchestrating, Codex implementing, and Codex and Claude reviewing.

plugins.name: repo-docs
plugins.description: Keeps a repository's instruction files correct and progressively disclosed.
